messages.subject: Problems after update with the loading of files
parts:
Hello,

I used seewave during the summer and I am working again with the same sound files and the same script. I have had to reinstall my operative system, I now run Mavericks in a MacBook Pro and R 3.0.2

After loading the sound loadSample() I want to filter the sound and I get the following error:

Error in inputw(wave = wave, f = f) : 
  trying to get slot "bits" from an object of a basic class ("matrix") with no slots

I am afraid I have no idea what it means.
I get the same error trying to use the addsilw() function.

Any help would be appreciated.

Cheers, 
Greta
